investigations.title: Trace the modeled link-state lifecycle
investigations.objective: Find the current run and reconstruct its ordered link-state lifecycle.
investigations.question: Which modeled entity changed state, and did Splunk observe the complete lifecycle?
investigations.expected_finding: Six events for one run show the fictional edge router progressing from baseline through recovery.
investigations.explanation: The run identifier is NetSpout-specific correlation metadata. The ordered phase field connects each event to the same modeled enterprise-state transition.
investigations.hint: Start by confirming one run identifier and then compare event order by time and phase.

investigations.title: Correlate standards-based interface degradation evidence
investigations.objective: Reconstruct one test interface degradation from independent native receiver observations.
investigations.question: Do SNMP and gNMI observations describe the same bounded interface lifecycle?
investigations.expected_finding: Receiver-observed records share the test run, entity, interface, and ordered lifecycle while retaining their distinct native evidence boundaries.
investigations.explanation: Correlation fields are NetSpout lab metadata added after native receipt; they do not claim a vendor-defined cross-protocol schema.
investigations.hint: Confirm receiver observation for each source before comparing the correlated phase and interface fields.

scenarios.title: Modeled Link-State Lifecycle
scenarios.description: A standards-structured lab scenario showing an interface transition from baseline through recovery.
scenarios.story: A fictional branch uplink deteriorates, goes down, is detected, and returns to service.
scenarios.technical_description: One modeled interface lifecycle is encoded as six RFC 5424 structured messages and delivered to the configured local Splunk destination over the declared HEC lab path.
learning_objectives: Distinguish generated, sent, and Splunk-observed evidence.
Follow one correlated incident through ordered lifecycle phases.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The user proves that all six modeled lifecycle events were generated, dispatched, indexed with the expected sourcetype, and correlated to one run.
scenarios.baseline_description: The fictional branch user depends on an edge-router uplink that begins in a healthy modeled state.
scenarios.incident_description: The modeled uplink degrades and transitions down, affecting the fictional user path before recovering.
scenarios.discovery_prompt: Determine which entity changed state and whether Splunk observed the complete modeled lifecycle.
learning_hints: Compare generated and Splunk-observed counts before interpreting the timeline.
Use the run identifier only for this NetSpout lab; it is not a production field.
scenarios.business_impact: Demonstrates how loss of a branch uplink can interrupt application reachability.

scenarios.title: Test Enterprise Interface Degradation
scenarios.description: A bounded native scenario correlating SNMP and gNMI from one shared enterprise state plan.
scenarios.story: The primary uplink on cisco-asr9k-pe1 degrades, fails over, and recovers while native SNMP and gNMI independently observe the shared state.
scenarios.technical_description: The evidence-backed service_provider_cisco target cisco-asr9k-pe1 and existing interface HundredGigE0/0/0/1 drive both native paths. SNMP uses its existing IF-MIB ifIndex.1 wire identity and gNMI uses the matching existing OpenConfig interface path.
learning_objectives: Separate source-native transport evidence from destination HEC delivery.
Correlate one interface lifecycle without assuming vendor-specific field semantics.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The user identifies one shared test interface lifecycle and verifies each native receiver boundary independently of HEC delivery.
scenarios.baseline_description: The fictional test uplink begins within its modeled healthy bounds.
scenarios.incident_description: Modeled error and utilization indicators rise, the test interface degrades, and the same interface later recovers.
scenarios.discovery_prompt: Determine whether all required native channels observed the same test entity and interface lifecycle.
learning_hints: A successful UDP send does not prove collector receipt.
Treat NetSpout correlation fields as lab-only metadata.
scenarios.business_impact: Models reduced application reachability through one fictional enterprise uplink without asserting production or vendor behavior.
